notes.title: Patch 3 & Preview free additional content
notes.notes:
Hello dear gamers!

Anticorps VR got patch today. Let's take a look at the details of the fixes:

- Set menus more far/up of the hands to increase the comfort of use 
- Hand's now use relative position tracking (correcting angles for oculus useurs).
- Increase the number of workers provided by a house: 8 to 9
- Increase the amount of stone produced by deposit: 10 to 15
- Some correction of the behavior of NPCs.
- Some tweak for increase fps on end game.


Preview additional content that will be added for free in the coming months :

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes:
Thank's for all the feedback.

- Correcting a problem with the Oculus controller grips, all grip controls are replaced by the B / Y buttons. (build menu will now work normally).

- Correcting a display problem when failing the boss of the artery mode.


Pour les Français, l'écran d'accueil est en Français, dans le hub du jeu ouvrez le menu avec le bouton menu du contrôleur gauche et changer la langue, le jeu sera en Français et vous n'aurai plus à faire cette manipulation.

notes.title: Work hard on release
notes.notes:
Welcome to Anticorps Vr this is a strategy/Management game which proposes a gameplay on 3 axes:

-Build colony
-Build Tower defenses
-Action with your weapon.

The game offers 12h gameplay to be completed (it depends on your performance, it can be more).

A game session lasts about 30/40 minutes. There are 9 modes on the release.

Free movement : full directional movement systems like teleportation, touchpad control (both are enabled together, you can turn off touchpad if you wish) and climbing.

We chose a crazy context, to create a universe with unique gameplay, to make it a spectacular strategy game.

The game start slowly, but you have to quickly analyze the procedural generated terrain and make the right decisions for the placement of your buildings / defenses. The tension is progressive, the more the game advances, the more you will be attacked. At the end of the game you will be focused on your defensive tasks using your weapons. Act on the economy of your colony at this moment will be complicated, it will be necessary to have prepared a good yield.

Your weapons are subjects to management too, you have a stock of ammunition for each (even the hammer), you have to think carefully before using them and you have to build the appropriate buildings to reload, improve your weapons, improve production or even the turrets.

The game has many subtleties that make the strategic part interesting.

Future for the game:

We work on oculus rift version. Additional content will be added to the game during its lifetime: game modes, buildings / turret, weapons or any other suggestions you make.

We are preparing the release of the game, in order to make you feel the best sensations.

We are looking forward to reading you.

*Anticorps means Antibody.
